newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle brisk $106/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle brisk $106/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold $105.00 to $106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in brisk trading, unchanged from Monday, but up $3.00 from last week's top, market sources said.
About 40,000 head sold near midday, including cattle sold on a live basis at $65.00, up $1.00 from Monday, they said.

Gains were powered by strong beef price advances, the sources said. Beef prices were sharply higher amid tight supplies and retail fill-in buying for end of the month and Independence Day holiday beef featuring, they said.
